name: Synn
message: 「I know resting my body is important and all, but......」
I never realized having neither a part-time job nor Student Council duties would leave me at such a loose end.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Lord Demon, let's head back and take a nap or somethin'.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wouldn't that kind of feel like a waste?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then let's go peek on what Ria-chan's up to!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh......? What the hell, ain't that the little shrimp from the other day?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's rude to say things like that. You're way more of a shrimp than she is, Paqy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, the great me is gonna hide out for a bit.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I ain't putting up with getting abused like last time again.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's really not that rough of a kid, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if she doesn't have work today......?」
Since I'm here, I might as well call out to her.

name: Lolotte
message: 「What's the matter, President, shouting so loudly like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it's just you, Lolotte. Don't startle me like that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I was in the middle of exploring, you see, and I happened to spot you, President, so I couldn't help myself.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. I caught sight of Macaron, so I was just thinking of saying hi.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I could have sworn you were keeping tabs on her so your little sister wouldn't turn into a delinquent」

name: Synn
message: 「I was just a little curious about what Macaron gets up to on her days off」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let's get right to secretly tailing your little sister♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Shouldn't we just call out to her like normal?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Non, non! Where would the fun be in that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In life, a bit of playfulness is necessary from time to time」

name: Synn
message: 「Is now really the time for that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Absolutely not! That would ruin the whole operation!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She went right into the academy, didn't she?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm. Things are getting suspicious now♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn and Lolotte. What are you two doing in a place like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, well, it's not like we're trying to break your rules or anything, Ria...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We're in the middle of tailing his little sister, you see」

name: Ria
message: 「Macaron? What business does she have at the academy?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's what we're about to find out」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. Still, peeping isn't very nice」

name: Synn
message: 「Right? You seem like you'd be a frequent victim of peeping yourself, Ria」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, Synn, you pervert! Girls are going to hate you, you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We already know the president is a pervert, so let's hurry and follow your sister!」

name: Ria
message: 「Understanding how my juniors think is part of my duty as a senior, after all!\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As the saying goes, when in Rome, do as the perverts do♪」

name: Ria
message: 「That spot gets great sunlight, so it looks super warm」
So Macaron relaxes like that too.

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh, whew. It's just you, little angel」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I told you, I'm not an angel!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh, Big Brother, and even Big Sister」

name: Macaron
message: 「Why are you guys here? Isn't today a day off?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... we just had a little Student Council business...」

name: Synn
message: 「And then we just happened to spot you, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nuh-uh. When I was looking for Big Brother the other day, I thought it looked nice and sunny」

name: Ria
message: 「I get that. Sunbathing feels really nice, doesn't it」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah. Something about it just warms up my body and calms me down」

name: Macaron
message: 「B-But like I said earlier, it's not like I'm slacking off or anything!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I have the day off from work today, so I was just thinking of finding somewhere warm to do some thinking」

name: Ria
message: 「Macaron-chan... could it be that you're bad with the cold?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh!? N-N-No, not particularly, or anything like that, not really, um, auu...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm fine! If I do this, I'm totally okay! I can handle it!」
No sooner does she say that than she pulls her hood all the way over her head.

name: Macaron
message: 「Looks cool, right~? I made this coat all by myself, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's some impressive handiwork. I'll have to take notes」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mumble mumble... If you're gonna say that, it's a Kopinkuma... zzz...」

name: Ria
message: 「Somehow, it's making me want to curl up and lounge around too\s07」

name: Macaron
message: 「Wah, hey, go over there, Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it. I'll scoot over here, then」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hey, Synn!? Don't go touching weird places, bad!!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother's so ba~d, what a per~v」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Isn't that going a bit too far?!\s01」

name: Macaron
message: 「If it's me, no matter where you touch... I won't get mad, okay?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, come o~n, now's your cha~nce?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oww~ie. Geez, it was just a joke」

name: Macaron
message: 「Not my problem. It's your fault for being a pervert, Big Brother」

name: Macaron
message: 「Whatever. I'm gonna take a nap too」
Macaron flings her body down onto the warm grass.

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, no, I was just thinking how defenseless she looks」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I think I'll take a nap too」
Ah, the sunlight is so warm...

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, don't leave your senpai out of it」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. It looks like she went off somewhere while we were asleep」
Did we end up bothering her after all...?

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, Lolotte, you'll catch a cold if you sleep with your tummy sticking out」

name: Ria
message: 「I wanted to ask Macaron-chan a little bit about the Demon Lord, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Somehow, I feel like I was able to relax a whole lot」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, me too. We'll have to thank Macaron-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, let's do our best with Student Council activities again starting tomorrow!」
